comments.author: @LongHồng-w1n
comments.text: This is the reason I love Thailand so much.   Food is so good and ready before you are even up!  The price and quality from the food vendors are top notch and you can find anything within your budget.  I can't wait to come back soon!

comments.author: @MisogiNate
comments.text: Mark what do you recommend for people like me who are never hungry? I live in Thailand and like Thai food enough. But my excitement comes nowhere near to matching yours.

comments.author: @YouTubeDave-tp7ij
comments.text: I'm sure that $150 curry is an amazing experience, but I've never been one to spend so much for food.   Especially considering that you can eat well with $1 street food.  Everyone has their preference.    Maybe I would do it once for the experience, but it certainly isn't something that I'd do regularly.

comments.author: @Lovelilou64
comments.text: that $5.92 seafood plate looks divine.   I was surprised to see you bite into the stuffed squid so easily.  Squid is usually so chewy.  Though I guess you did say it was a little bit chewy/rubbery.  But still looks more tender than what I am accustomed to.  Must be especially fresh and tenderized or marinated.  I have to find that place!  For food, and I want to meet that Aunty.  In my next life I want to be a Thai who runs a little kitchen like this and have a little apartment above or next door.  It looks like a dream life for me.  Here's hoping!  It's amazing that's considered to be expensive, given so much seafood!  Couldn't touch that dish for under $50 anywhere in the U.S.
